text:
maya (Product): Quick sync — Customer Orion asked for low-latency burst capacity + private deploy checklist for pilot. Need cross-team sequencing and firm launch criteria by end of week.

sam (Eng): Can we list the blockers? I think runtime batching + infra prewarm are the two big ones.

li (Runtime): Correct. Two runtime items: (1) KV-cache prewarm for pinned sessions, (2) conservative batch sizing for <50ms p95. Both need test windows.

ana (Infra): For prewarm we need reserved slots in the dedicated pool. How many concurrent warm sessions are we targeting?

maya (Product): Target = 20 concurrent customer sessions for the initial pilot. If we hit that, we evaluate auto-burst.

li (Runtime): 20 concurrent pinned sessions implies ~3x nominal memory headroom for KV cache per node. I'll need a node spec (GPU mem) and a validated quantization profile.

sam (Eng): I'll map it to the feature rollout: phase A (pilot): pinned sessions + telemetry only; phase B: scale to 100 sessions + cost-optimizations. Phase A needs runtime + infra done.

ana (Infra): For phase A reserving 4 x A100-equivalent machines should cover 20 sessions with headroom. Need commit from finance for reserved capacity or we'll use burst capacity pricing.

maya (Product): I'll confirm budget today. Also customer requires SOC2-style audit logs for session isolation.

tess (Security): For audit logs we need KMS integration and retention policy. Private deploy variant needs HSM support; on hosted we can provide redact hooks. I'll write the minimum acceptance checklist.

devops-bot: Deployment plan created: deploy/1766001234/adaptive-burst-pilot, canary window = 30m, rollback threshold = 5% error rate increase.

sam (Eng): Can we get a short launch checklist in this thread? I'll own runtime tasks.

maya (Product): Checklist draft — please comment inline: 1) Runtime: KV prewarm end-to-end test w/ 20 concurrent sessions; 2) Runtime: Latency p95 < 60ms under load; 3) Infra: 4 reserved nodes provisioned + autoscale guardrails; 4) Security: KMS + audit hooks configured; 5) QA: Canary traffic from internal customer; 6) Product: Acceptance signoff from Orion.

li (Runtime): Adding: 7) Fallback model variant tested if quantized path degrades quality; 8) Metrics: token-level cost and latency per session emitted.

ana (Infra): Adding: 9) Network egress rules for private pilot validated; 10) Capacity alerting thresholds created (cpu/gpu/mem/token throughput).

tess (Security): Adding: 11) Dataflow diagram + threat model reviewed; 12) Audit log retention configured (90d) and access controls set.

sam (Eng): I'll schedule a short load test tomorrow 10:00am PT. Who can join to validate telemetry and rollout hooks?

maya (Product): li + ana + tess pls try to attend. If you can't, post signoffs here.

li (Runtime): I'll be there.

ana (Infra): Tentative — might be in infra oncall but will try.

tess (Security): I can join the tail end for the audit validation, otherwise signoff after review.

maya (Product): Great. Action items: - maya: confirm budget today - sam: schedule load test + create canary traffic script - li: prepare prewarm test harness and fallback validation - ana: provision nodes + alerting - tess: publish acceptance checklist and KMS config snippet

sam (Eng): I'll paste the canary curl in thread after I create the script.

maya (Product): Thanks — if we can get all signoffs by Friday EOD we can run the pilot next week. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Reminder: set SLA tag on the release if pilot promises 99.9% availability to customer.

sam (Eng): Noted — I'll set the tag in the release notes.

maya (Product): Closing loop — I'll update the roadmap ticket and ping execs after signoffs.

li (Runtime): Quick note: plan for a canary fallback to the hosted smaller model if quantized path shows >2% semantic drift during tests.

maya (Product): Noted. We'll include that in acceptance criteria.

sam (Eng): Short snippet for canary traffic (local test):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.internal/redwood/generate -d '{"model":"pilot-v1","input":"ortho test $i"}'; done
```

ana (Infra): Good. I'll wire up monitoring for that endpoint.

maya (Product): Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the load test and post signoffs here.
